name: Mirror with Animals and Birds
material: bronze inset with gilded-silver relief decoration
summary: The silver inset of this mirror back was decorated with several hand-beaten techniques. High-relief birds, beasts, and foliage were hammered from the underside (repoussé) and finely chiseled on the front (chased).
